investor.subject: A deal, start to finish
investor.preheader: Screen, set targets, stress it, decide.
investor.headline: A deal, start to finish

body.text: Pick one of your saved deals and walk it through four steps.
You have not saved a deal yet, so here is the walk-through on the sample property.

body: 1. Screen it. Check that rent, taxes, and insurance are numbers you can source, not defaults.
2. Set your targets. The Offer Ceiling is the highest price that still meets them.
3. Stress it. The downside view shows which assumption hurts most if it is wrong.
4. Decide. If asking is above your ceiling, you know the gap and what would have to change to close it.

agent.subject: A client deal, start to finish
agent.preheader: Screen, set targets, stress it, send it.
agent.headline: A client deal, start to finish

body.text: Pick one of your saved deals and walk it through four steps.
You have not saved a deal yet, so here is the walk-through on the sample property.

body: 1. Screen it. Check that rent, taxes, and insurance are numbers you can source, not defaults.
2. Set the client's targets. The Offer Ceiling is the highest price that still meets them.
3. Stress it. The downside view shows which assumption hurts most if it is wrong.
4. Send it. Share a read-only link or a memo. On Agent Pro both carry your logo, and the deal sits on that client's page in your roster.
